name: Projeto Kãmora
source:
Discover a glimpse of the world of Kãmora through the eyes of Kizz, a gnoll, revealing a realm teeming with diverse races within a land marked by deep segregation.

Follow Kizz’s story as he learns from his friends how to make the most of the little we have.

[From [url=https://meekyeen.itch.io/projeto-kmora]Itch.io[/url]]
